caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old-fashioned flat iron, which appears to be made of metal. The iron is positioned at an angle, showing its rectangular base and a thick, arched handle that rises from either end of the base. The handle exhibits a rough, uneven texture and has a dark, almost black color at the top, transitioning into a brownish tone where it connects to the base. The base of the iron is depicted in various shades of brown and rust, with some darker areas suggesting wear or corrosion. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decorations. The artist’s signature, “S. Ezganians,” is present in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Flatiron
